prompt.main: Create an energetic 60-second product demo for a modern project management platform using the Feature-Benefit-Tie Down framework. Show 5 killer features, each followed by clear benefits and compelling tie-down statements. Open with a hook about project chaos, then systematically showcase: (1) Real-time collaboration boards with automatic sync, (2) AI-powered task prioritization, (3) Cross-team dependency mapping, (4) Automated status reporting, and (5) Integrated time tracking. Each feature should get 10 seconds with smooth UI animations showing the feature in action, a clear benefit statement, and a rhetorical tie-down question. Use bright, vibrant colors, fast-paced editing, upbeat electronic music, and confident typography. End with metrics showing 3x faster project completion.
prompt.opening: Hook: Screen shows chaos: 47 unread Slack messages, 12 overdue tasks, confused team members asking 'What's the priority?', manager asking for status updates. Freeze frame. Text appears: 'There's a better way to manage projects.' Logo reveal. Music drops into confident beat.
prompt.middle:
FEATURE 1 - Real-Time Collaboration Boards (10s):
- Visual: Team members across different locations all viewing same board. One person drags a task to 'In Progress'—everyone's screens update instantly. Another adds a comment—notification appears immediately for relevant team members.
- Voiceover: '[Product] gives you real-time collaboration boards where every change syncs instantly across your entire team—which means no more version confusion or outdated information—everyone's always on the same page. That saves hours of confusion every week, doesn't it?'
- On-screen: 'Real-Time Sync · Zero Lag · Always Current'
- Tie-down visual: Checkmark appears, happy team members nodding

FEATURE 2 - AI Task Prioritization (10s):
- Visual: Tasks automatically reorder based on deadlines, dependencies, and team capacity. AI highlights top 3 priorities for each person. Smart suggestions: 'Based on your skills, you should tackle Design Review next.'
- Voiceover: 'AI automatically prioritizes your tasks based on deadlines, dependencies, and team workload—so you always know what matters most—and focus drives results, doesn't it?'
- On-screen: 'AI Prioritization · Smart Suggestions · Zero Guesswork'
- Tie-down visual: Productivity graph trending up

FEATURE 3 - Dependency Mapping (10s):
- Visual: Gantt-style view showing interconnected tasks. One task gets delayed—system automatically adjusts all dependent tasks and notifies affected team members. Timeline recalculates. Visual lines showing dependencies.
- Voiceover: 'Automatic dependency mapping means when one task shifts, every related task adjusts instantly—which prevents bottlenecks before they happen—and preventing problems beats fixing them, right?'
- On-screen: 'Smart Dependencies · Auto-Adjust · Prevent Delays'
- Tie-down visual: Warning icon turning to green checkmark

FEATURE 4 - Automated Status Reports (10s):
- Visual: Calendar hits Friday 5 PM. Status report auto-generates pulling data from all tasks, showing progress, blockers, and upcoming milestones. Report sends to stakeholders. Manager reviews instead of manually creating.
- Voiceover: 'Automated status reports pull real data and send themselves every Friday—saving your team hours of manual reporting—and time saved is money earned, isn't it?'
- On-screen: 'Auto Reports · Every Friday · Zero Manual Work'
- Tie-down visual: Clock showing 5 hours saved

FEATURE 5 - Integrated Time Tracking (10s):
- Visual: Time tracking built into tasks. Click task, timer starts. Automatic time suggestions based on task type. Weekly reports show where time actually goes. Budget tracking for client projects.
- Voiceover: 'Built-in time tracking shows exactly where hours go and keeps projects on budget—which means accurate billing and better planning—and knowing your numbers is how you grow, right?'
- On-screen: 'Time Tracking · Budget Alerts · Accurate Billing'
- Tie-down visual: Dollar signs with positive metrics
prompt.closing: Rapid montage: All 5 features working together in harmony. Multiple teams collaborating smoothly, projects moving from start to finish. Metrics appear: 'Projects Completed: +3x Faster', 'Team Productivity: +67%', 'Time Wasted on Admin: -80%'. Happy teams high-fiving. End card: '[Product] - Projects Done Right' with CTA: 'Start Free · No Credit Card'. Upbeat music reaches crescendo.
visualGuidelines: Use vibrant brand colors: Electric blue, energetic orange, success green
Fast-paced editing: Each feature section is exactly 10 seconds, no meandering
UI animations at 60fps with smooth easing functions
Tie-down moments get visual emphasis: Checkmarks, thumbs up, nodding heads
Show diverse teams: Different ages, backgrounds, time zones
Split-screen comparisons: Old way vs. new way
Isometric board views for spatial understanding
Typography: Bold sans-serif, high contrast, animated counters for metrics
Transitions: Quick cuts with whoosh sounds between features
Benefits appear as animated text overlays during demonstrations
